About BloodConnect

BloodConnect is a blood donor platform designed to connect blood donors with patients who need blood.

Our mission is to make blood donor searching easier, encourage voluntary blood donation and help save lives.

Our Mission

Make safe and voluntary blood donation more accessible.

Our Vision

A world where no patient suffers due to a shortage of blood.
